guide.title: Documentation guide
guide.description: Read, write, and share documents with diagrams and HTML.
guide.body:
This sample organizes a team's technical documentation into three levels. Expand the sidebar to browse guides, architecture, and reference material.

## Start here

| Goal | Page |
| --- | --- |
| Run the editor | [Getting started](doc:getting-started) |
| Write an article | [Writing guide](doc:writing) |
| Add a diagram | [Figures and HTML](doc:media) |
| Understand the design | [Architecture](doc:architecture) |

## Overview

:::figure(overview.svg)[From source documents to the viewer]

The docs root contains documents, figures, and HTML fragments. The compiler validates these files and produces an artifact.

## Explore resources

Open Resources in the sidebar to inspect figures, document icons, and the intro HTML resource.

:::callout[Try a different language]
- Use the globe icon at the top right of the preview to open another version of this article.
- Untranslated articles display the source until you save a translation.
- The editor language is a separate setting in the gear menu.
:::

getting-started.title: Getting started
getting-started.description: Launch the sample and edit your first document.
getting-started.body:
## Launch the sample

Run this command from the repository root:

```bash
mise run dev
```

Open the URL printed in the terminal. Select an article in the sidebar, edit its title or body, and save your changes.

## Edit a translation

Choose English from the globe icon at the top right of the preview. Changes are saved to the English JSON catalog, while the source Markdown stays unchanged.

To edit another collection:

```bash
mise run edit ../my-docs
```

See [Folder layout](doc:layout) for the shared document hierarchy and resource locations.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: How the viewer, compiler, and rendering core work together.
architecture.body:
## Responsibilities

:::graph[Component dependencies]
[viewer]: Viewer and editor @app
[compiler]: Compiler @app
[core]: Rendering and types @lib
[viewer] -> [compiler]
[viewer] -> [core]
[compiler] -> [core]
:::

The viewer reads documents and language catalogs. The compiler validates their structure and references. The core renders the result.

See [Processing flow](doc:flow) and [Data model](doc:data-model) for detailed examples.
